description: This file defines the EnumValueValidator class which implements custom validation logic for enum values in Java, ensuring input strings match accepted enum constants in a case-insensitive manner.

classes.name: EnumValueValidator
classes.description: A custom validator class for enum values, implementing the ConstraintValidator interface to validate string input against enum constants.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the set of accepted enum constant names in lowercase, extracted from the annotation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the given string value is non-null and exists within the accepted enum names set, case-insensitive.
